This repo is empty — no dashboard, monitoring, or infra config in it — so I can't independently verify the dashboard for you. I don't have access to your observability stack (Datadog/Grafana/etc.) from here.

But there's a real gap worth flagging before you post the all-clear: you said EU checkout traffic moved to the new routing cluster last month, and this is the *same* dashboard you've used all year. If that dashboard's queries/data source weren't updated to include the new cluster, "flat at zero for 25 minutes" could mean "no data coming in from EU" rather than "no errors" — a silent blind spot, not a resolved incident.

Before closing, I'd check one thing specifically: confirm the dashboard shows non-zero *request volume* from the EU/new-cluster traffic during this window, not just zero errors. If volume is also zero or suspiciously low, the dashboard likely isn't capturing that cluster at all, and you'd want a quick spot-check of EU checkout error rates directly on the new cluster before calling it resolved.

That's a 2-minute check that could save you from reopening this after the all-hands — want me to help draft the all-clear message with a caveat noting that EU-cluster verification is pending, so you're not blocked either way?
